metadata.title: Macro Nature Collage with Hand-Lettered Display

retrievalProfile.description: A dark-background collage featuring circular macro crops of organic textures paired with informal, hand-drawn white lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured composition where three large overlapping circular masks reveal extreme macro details of butterfly wings, accompanied by a vertical stack of smaller circular icons and informal, white hand-drawn display text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping circular masks against a solid dark field
Contrast between organic macro textures and flat background
Vertical alignment of small icons balancing the large circular crops
Informal hand-lettered text providing a human touch to scientific imagery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three large circles dominate the upper two-thirds; text and small icons occupy the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central yellow macro circle acts as the primary focal point due to its brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large top-left circle, down to the central yellow circle, then right to the blue-red circle, finally settling on the text and vertical icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space surrounds the circular elements, creating a 'void' effect.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for typography and small icons.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, blue, and earthy browns within the macro textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the macro details against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular stroke widths suggesting a felt-tip marker
Mixed case or inconsistent capitalization heights
Rounded terminals and organic, slightly wobbly curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' with a narrow, vertical posture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-drawn style paired with small photographic icons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, handwritten quality of the original.
Maintains the legibility while keeping the soft edges.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage on a black background featuring three large overlapping circles containing macro textures of butterfly wings (brown/white, yellow/black, and blue/red). Add a vertical row of six small circular icons on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn white lettering at the bottom center with an informal, marker-like style.

verificationChecks: Are the macro textures contained within clean circular masks?
Is the text white and hand-drawn in appearance?
Are there small circular icons stacked vertically?

mustAchieve: High contrast between textures and background

postGenerationChecks: Confirm vertical alignment of small icons
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Texture Circles + Dark Void + Hand-Lettered Display
